source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.11.3, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Gunpowder 75 feesad potassium nitrate, 15 feesad lakri ke koyle aur 10 feesad sulfur ka mota mixture hai. Koyle ka carbon bunyadi fuel hai, nitrate oxidiser, aur sulfur izafi fuel jo powder ko tez jalata hai. Jalne par: 10KNO3(s) + 3S(s) + 8C(s) se 2K2CO3(s) + 3K2SO4(s) + 6CO2(g) + 5N2(g).

blocks.prompt: Gunpowder ki tarkeeb aur us ke jalne ka reaction dein (exercise Q.2l), aur wazeh karein ke band jagah mein yeh kyun phat-ta hai.
blocks.explanation: 75 feesad KNO3, 15 feesad koyla, 10 feesad sulfur; 10KNO3 + 3S + 8C se 2K2CO3 + 3K2SO4 + 6CO2 + 5N2. Nitrate apni oxygen khud deta hai, to jalne ko hawa nahi chahiye aur yeh bohat tez hai, aur solids se bane garam gas ke gyarah moles band jagah mein shiddat se phailte hain.

items: Gunpowder: 75% KNO3 (oxidiser), 15% koyla (fuel), 10% S (izafi fuel); 10KNO3 + 3S + 8C se 2K2CO3 + 3K2SO4 + 6CO2 + 5N2.
